13 / Cybersecurity

Moleaks — A leaked-data search platform

Deep search by email, phone number, domain and face recognition.

Year
2026
Scope
Cybersecurity
  • 4
    search vectors — email, phone, domain, face
  • M+
    rows scanned in seconds
  • SSR
    fast, SEO-friendly UI on Next.js

01 / Overview

Moleaks is a verification tool for individuals and cybersecurity specialists. It shows whether their data appears in leaked databases on the internet or the dark web — an email address, a mobile number, a domain name or a face can be checked.

02 / The problem

People often learn that their data has leaked only after an account is compromised. Leak databases are scattered, unformatted and hold millions of rows, which makes manual checking impossible.

03 / Our approach

Search and analysis are separated. A .NET Core API handles thousands of simultaneous requests while heavy analysis runs in the background with Python and DeepScanner. Database indexing strategies let millions of rows be scanned in seconds.

04 / The result

Users can check an email, a phone number or a whole corporate domain and get a detailed report on the leak’s source, date and type.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Multi-parameter search

    Fast checks across leaked databases by email, mobile number and IP address.

  • 02

    Domain analysis

    Finds leaked accounts tied to a corporate or personal domain.

  • 03

    Face recognition search

    Identifies people in internet images by facial features.

  • 04

    Deep scanning

    Automated analysis of large volumes of leaked data.

  • 05

    Security reports

    Detailed reports on each leak’s source, date and type.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Asynchronous processing

    Python and DeepScanner run in the background, so large analyses never slow the main system.

  2. Optimised database

    MSSQL indexing lets millions of rows be scanned in seconds.

  3. High-performance API

    .NET Core securely handles thousands of concurrent search requests.

07 / Technology

Tech stack.

Frontend
  • React
  • Next.js (server-side rendering)
Database
  • MS SQL Server with indexing strategies
Analysis
  • Python
  • DeepScanner
